Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherform
Punchline: Install the Aetherform body and build collection-specific physics presets.
Description: Use /aetherform to install the body through Penumbra, select a collection, adjust physics, and fit vanilla gear on equip.
Changelog: Vanilla tops and bottoms now use a baked AF body map. Garment bindings persist across shape changes and restarts. Earlier editable fits remain available.
